description:
AzureVirtualMachine: the concrete, scheduled VM request for Azure.

You normally do not create this by hand: banlieue's controller does,
owned by the `VirtualMachine` it was scheduled from, and the Azure
provider creates the NIC and VM and reports CAPI-shaped status.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.

spec.description:
AzureVirtualMachine: the concrete, scheduled VM request for Azure.

You normally do not create this by hand: banlieue's controller does,
owned by the `VirtualMachine` it was scheduled from, and the Azure
provider creates the NIC and VM and reports CAPI-shaped status.

acceleratedNetworking.description:
Enable accelerated networking on the NIC. The image must not
configure the VF itself (ADR-0163 Decision 3).

desiredPowerState.description:
Desired power state, resolved from the parent `VirtualMachine`.
`PoweredOff` deallocates the VM, which stops compute billing
(ADR-0164 Decision 3). `Suspended` is refused.

failureDomain.description:
CAPI contract (optional): failure domain placement, the name of one of
the `Provider`'s failure domains (one per availability zone).

imageVersionId.description:
Resource ID of the Compute Gallery image version to boot, from the
`VMImage`'s `azure` source (a hand-published `Template`, ADR-0162
Decision 4).

osDiskSizeGiB.description: OS disk size in GiB, from the `VMClass` (ADR-0160 Decision 4).

osDiskSku.description:
Managed-disk SKU of the OS disk (`Premium_LRS`, `StandardSSD_LRS`),
from the storage class's `sku` target.

providerID.description:
CAPI contract: Provider ID for the resulting Node. Format:
`azure:///subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/<name>`.
Set by the provider once the VM exists.

providerRef.description:
The `Provider` whose connection names the subscription, region and
resource group.

namespace.description:
Namespace of the `Provider`. Defaults to the referrer's namespace.

Only `banlieue-controller` may set this: a machine naming a provider in
another namespace is a placement that skipped scheduling, so an
admission policy reserves the field to the controller's identity.

size.description:
VM size (`Standard_D2s_v5`), resolved from the `Provider`'s
`instanceSizes` mapping for the `VMClass` (ADR-0160).

subnetId.description:
Resource ID of the subnet the NIC is created in, from the network
class's `subnetId` target for this zone.

trustedLaunch.description:
Trusted Launch: Secure Boot and a vTPM (ADR-0165). Set from the
`VMClass`'s `tpmEnabled`; the image definition must declare Trusted
Launch support.

zone.description:
Availability zone the VM is created in, as the subscription names it
(`1`, `2`, `3`). Resolved from the failure domain's `labels.zone`.

status.description:
Observed state of an AzureVirtualMachine, shaped to the CAPI v1beta2
InfraMachine status contract. The non-contract fields mean what they mean
on the siblings, so the controller's status mirror treats backends alike.

addresses.description:
CAPI contract field (optional): the NIC's private address. No public
address in v1.

items.description: A typed machine address. Mirrors CAPI's `clusterv1.MachineAddress`.

type.description: Address type. Accepted: Hostname, ExternalIP, InternalIP, ExternalDNS, InternalDNS.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description: lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another. This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description: message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition. This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description: observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon. For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description: reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition. Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field, and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API. The value should be a CamelCase string. This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

createFailures.description:
Consecutive failed creates of this generation: the provider waits
`min(5 min * 2^(n - 1), 1 h)` before creating again (ADR-0173
Decision 5). Reset when the VM exists.

failureDomain.description: CAPI contract field (optional): observed failure domain.

guestInstalled.description:
Sticky: the guest reported ready once (ADR-0163 Decision 1,
ADR-0043 Decision 5).

provisioned.description:
True when the infrastructure provider reports that the resource's
infrastructure is fully provisioned.

observedGeneration.description: The `metadata.generation` this status was computed from.

observedPowerState.description: The VM's last observed run state (deallocated reads `PoweredOff`).

osDiskTagged.description:
Sticky: the OS disk carries this machine's ownership tags. ARM takes
none in the VM body, so the provider merges them onto the disk once
the VM exists (ADR-0173).

pendingOperation.description: The ARM operation in flight, if any.

kind.description:
Which header the URL came from: `AsyncOperation`
(`Azure-AsyncOperation`) or `Location`.

url.description:
The operation URL ARM returned. The provider polls it only when it
sits under the ARM endpoint it is configured for.

vmName.description: The VM's resource name, derived from this object's UID.
